Partner APIs
novita.ai/models

entries.before:
Prompt storage: On by default. Stores prompts and model responses for product improvements. Turn it off to enable ZDR, which also turns off passthrough models.
Passthrough models: On by default. Allows your organization to use models that forward prompts and responses to third-party providers. Passthrough requires prompt storage, so you can’t turn this toggle on while prompt storage is off.
entries.after:
Prompt storage: Off by default for new organizations. Stores prompts and model responses for product improvements. Turn it off to enable ZDR, which also turns off passthrough models.
Passthrough models: Allows models that forward prompts and responses to third-party providers. You can turn on passthrough models only while prompt storage is on.

entries.before: By default, Together stores the prompts you send and the responses models return, and may use them for product improvements. This data is not shared with third parties, and you can delete it at any time. Organization admins can turn storage off in privacy settings, which enables zero data retention (ZDR): request content is then not persisted or used for any secondary purpose. See zero data retention for what ZDR covers, how to enable it, and what Together retains.
entries.after: New organizations start with zero data retention (ZDR) enabled. When prompt storage is on, Together stores your prompts and model responses and may use them for product improvements. Together does not share this stored data with third parties, and you can delete it at any time.
